description: Read structured JSON for one processed Suparse document_id directly, without submitting an export job or saving a local file. Returns task_id, original_file, total_documents_extracted, and documents containing extracted_data. Get document IDs from extraction results or get_task_results (documents[].id); do not substitute a task_id. Use fetch_json_results for a multi-document JSON export or download_results to save an export. Does not wait for extraction to finish.
name: fetch_document_result
title: Fetch Document Result
